Asset type: a single collectible achievement icon for a cozy touch-only pixel farm game.
Scene/backdrop: genuinely transparent background, no backdrop at all.
Style/medium: very crisp flat 2D pixel art; chunky visible square pixel clusters and a tiny limited palette; warm cream-white wool, peach-pink face, dark burnt orange-brown outlines 1-2 logical pixels thick, little fresh green leaves and warm golden highlights. Match a friendly retro sheep achievement collection, rendered as if designed on a 48x48 pixel grid then enlarged using nearest-neighbor. Solid hard edges. Composition/framing: ONE compact, coherent square cutout centered with about 12 percent transparent margin on all sides, all parts fully inside the image. Strong simple silhouette and very few large details so it reads clearly when reduced to 28 pixels. No detached confetti or decorative dots.
Subject: A cute cream-white sheep wearing a vivid green travel scarf, looking upward at exactly three simple golden five-point stars close above its head. The sheep and stars form a single tight readable icon; brown hooves, rosy tiny cheek. Meaning: a little starlight journey.
